scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:schema: docker exec -i zelda-tracker-db psql -U zelda -d zelda_tracker -f - < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: node db/generate-seed.js && docker exec -i zelda-tracker-db psql -U zelda -d zelda_tracker -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < db/seed.sql
